title: The Constituency Development Fund Bill, 2023
sourceFile: C:\Dev\LawAndRegulations\Processed\The Constituency Development Fund (Amendment) Bill, N.A.B 2023.txt
summary: Sample extraction of the CDF bill covering decentralised management, committee governance, fund administration, project proposals, procurement, and reporting.
memorandumPoints: Decentralised management, disbursement, utilisation, and accountability of the Fund
Continuation of the CDF Committee and revised committee functions
Provincial Constituency Development Fund Committee establishment
Repeal and replacement of the Constituency Development Fund Act, 2018

sampleClauses.heading: Principles of management, disbursement and utilisation of Fund
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: A CDF application or project is submitted
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Require decentralised accountability, utilisation, and transparency checks before approval.

sampleClauses.heading: Administration of Fund
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: The CDF administration workflow or committee role changes
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Ensure the Fund is administered through the correct committee and control chain.

sampleClauses.heading: Accountability and transparency
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: A disbursement, utilisation report, or accountability exception is recorded
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Preserve transparent evidence for each disbursement and project decision.

sampleClauses.heading: Invitation for project proposals
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: A project proposal intake window opens
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Capture proposal evidence and route the proposal through the committee review process.

sampleClauses.heading: Procurement of services and works
sampleClauses.triggerCondition: A CDF project requires services or works procurement
sampleClauses.controlIntent: Route CDF-funded works and services through procurement compliance before award or payment.
